dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast light rings with jagged perimeter edges transitioning sharply from dark exterior pixels to lighter mottled interiors; most prominent in the dorsal-mid and posterior-mid regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the mid-lateral axis, particularly dense in the anterior-mid region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal-mid rings form an obtuse triangle; a series of prominent blobs form a curvilinear alignment following the dorsal silhouette curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous serpentine high-contrast line connecting multiple ring-like structures along the mid-lateral axis.
